titulo: The First Mound | Egyptian Mythology Ep. 1
descripcion: Before the pyramids and before the Nile, there was only a dark, endless ocean. Then a mound of earth rose from the water, a god created himself on top of it, and the first humans were born from his tears. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #EgyptianMythology #Mythology #AncientEgypt

titulo: Sky and Earth | Egyptian Mythology Ep. 2
descripcion: The earth and the sky were locked in an embrace so tight that nothing could live between them, until the god of air pushed them apart. Then Nut began swallowing the sun every night, and a clever god won five extra days from the moon in a board game. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #EgyptianMythology #Mythology #AncientEgypt

titulo: The Five Children of Nut | Egyptian Mythology Ep. 3
descripcion: On five days that belonged to no year, the sky goddess Nut gave birth to five children: a king, a falcon, a storm, and two sisters. One of them tore his way out of his mother, and he would never forgive his brother's crown. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #EgyptianMythology #Mythology #AncientEgypt

titulo: The Eye of Ra | Egyptian Mythology Ep. 4
descripcion: Ra, the sun god, grew old, and the humans he had made began to whisper that he could no longer rule. His answer was a lioness goddess, a flood of red beer, and a cow that carried him up into the sky. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #EgyptianMythology #Mythology #AncientEgypt

titulo: The Secret Name of Ra | Egyptian Mythology Ep. 5
descripcion: Ra had a secret name that no god had ever heard. Isis shaped a serpent from the old sun god's spit, and one bite later she held his life in her hands. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #EgyptianMythology #Mythology #AncientEgypt

titulo: The Murder of Osiris | Egyptian Mythology Ep. 6
descripcion: Osiris was the best king Egypt ever had, and his brother Set hated him for it. One night at a feast, Set offered a beautiful chest to whoever could fit inside, and a king lay down in it. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #EgyptianMythology #Mythology #AncientEgypt

titulo: Isis and the Fourteen Pieces | Egyptian Mythology Ep. 7
descripcion: Set tore his brother Osiris into fourteen pieces and scattered them across Egypt. Isis went looking for every one of them, and the god who put him back together invented the mummy. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #EgyptianMythology #Mythology #AncientEgypt

titulo: Horus in the Marshes | Egyptian Mythology Ep. 8
descripcion: Set had already murdered Osiris, and now he wanted Osiris's baby son dead too. So Isis fled into the marshes with seven scorpions as her guards, and when the poison came, she called out to the sun itself. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #EgyptianMythology #Mythology #AncientEgypt

titulo: The Contendings of Horus and Set | Egyptian Mythology Ep. 9
descripcion: Two gods fought for the throne of Egypt for eighty years, turning into hippos, racing stone boats, and tearing out each other's eyes. In the end it took a goddess in disguise and a single story to make the strongest god in Egypt convict himself. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #EgyptianMythology #Mythology #AncientEgypt

titulo: The Night Journey of Ra | Egyptian Mythology Ep. 10
descripcion: Every evening the sun god Ra sank into the land of the dead and sailed through twelve hours of darkness, with a serpent waiting to drown his boat. This is the story of his night journey, hour by hour, until he is reborn at dawn. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #EgyptianMythology #Mythology #AncientEgypt

titulo: The Weighing of the Heart | Egyptian Mythology Ep. 11
descripcion: To reach the afterlife, every ancient Egyptian had to stand before forty-two judges and swear what they had never done, while their own heart was weighed against a feather. This is the story of the Weighing of the Heart, the final test of Egyptian mythology. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #EgyptianMythology #Mythology #AncientEgypt

titulo: The Origin of the World | Greek Mythology Ep. 1
descripcion: Before the gods, before the heroes and the monsters, there was nothing but Chaos. This is how the Greek world was born: Gaia and Uranus, the Titans, Cronus swallowing his own children, the hidden baby Zeus, and the ten-year war that put the Olympians on the throne. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #GreekMythology #Mythology #GreekGods

titulo: Prometheus and the Stolen Fire | Greek Mythology Ep. 2
descripcion: Zeus ruled from Olympus, but humans were left cold and helpless. One Titan decided to defy the king of the gods. This is the story of Prometheus: the trick at Mecone, the stolen fire hidden in a fennel stalk, and the terrible punishment in the Caucasus. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #GreekMythology #Mythology #GreekGods

titulo: Pandora and the Box | Greek Mythology Ep. 3
descripcion: Zeus could not forgive the theft of fire, so he answered with a gift: the first woman, made of clay and crowned with every god's blessing. This is the story of Pandora, her jar, the evils that escaped, and the one thing left inside. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #GreekMythology #Mythology #GreekGods

titulo: The Five Ages of Man | Greek Mythology Ep. 4
descripcion: Gold, silver, bronze, heroes, iron: the Greeks said humanity fell through five ages, and that we live in the worst one. Hesiod's ancient prophecy may sound uncomfortably familiar. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #GreekMythology #Mythology #GreekGods

titulo: The Flood of Deucalion | Greek Mythology Ep. 5
descripcion: Zeus drowned the entire world to wipe out humanity. Only two people survived, and they rebuilt mankind from stones.,Meet King Lycaon, the first werewolf, and the flood that changed everything. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #GreekMythology #Mythology #GreekGods

titulo: The War of the Giants | Greek Mythology Ep. 6
descripcion: Gaia, furious that her Titan children were still chained in Tartarus, raised an army of Giants to tear down Olympus. The gods could not win alone: only a mortal, Heracles, could turn the tide of the Gigantomachy. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #GreekMythology #Mythology #GreekGods

titulo: Typhon, the Last Monster | Greek Mythology Ep. 7
descripcion: Gaia gave birth to a monster so vast his head brushed the stars, and the gods fled Olympus in terror. Only Zeus stood against Typhon, and he nearly lost everything. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #GreekMythology #Mythology #GreekGods

titulo: The Song of the Night | Hawaiian Mythology Ep. 1
descripcion: Before the sun, before the sea, before any land, there was only Pō: a night that was alive. This is the Kumulipo, the Hawaiian chant of creation, where the night gives birth and the very first living thing is a tiny coral polyp. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #HawaiianMythology #Mythology #Hawaii

titulo: Fire and Ice | Norse Mythology Ep. 1
descripcion: Before the gods, there was only a yawning gap between a world of ice and a world of fire. Where they met, the first giant was born, a cow licked the first god out of the ice, and Odin and his brothers made a choice that would shape everything. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: The World Made from a Giant | Norse Mythology Ep. 2
descripcion: The gods killed the first giant and built the whole world from his body: flesh for the earth, blood for the sea, bones for the mountains. His skull became the sky, held up by four dwarves. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: Yggdrasil and the Nine Worlds | Norse Mythology Ep. 3
descripcion: One enormous ash tree holds up nine worlds, and a dragon is gnawing at its roots. Meet the Norns who carve your fate, the squirrel who carries insults, and the rainbow bridge guarded by Heimdall. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: The War of the Gods | Norse Mythology Ep. 4
descripcion: Two families of gods went to war, and nobody won. The peace they made cost one god his head. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: Odin's Price for Wisdom | Norse Mythology Ep. 5
descripcion: Odin gave up an eye, hung nine nights from a tree, and stole the mead of poetry. What he saw in the future terrified him. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: The Wall of Asgard | Norse Mythology Ep. 6
descripcion: A stranger offered the gods an unbreakable wall, and the price was the Sun, the Moon and Freyja. Only Loki's trick could save them. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: The Treasures of the Gods | Norse Mythology Ep. 7
descripcion: Loki cut off Sif's golden hair for a joke, and to make amends he started a bet that cost him his head. Out of two dwarf forges came the spear of Odin, the ship of Freyr, the golden boar, the ring Draupnir, and Thor's hammer, Mjolnir. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: Loki's Children | Norse Mythology Ep. 8
descripcion: Loki secretly had three monstrous children: a wolf, a serpent and a half-dead girl. The gods cast them out, but only one chain could hold Fenrir, and it cost Tyr his hand. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: Thor Among the Giants | Norse Mythology Ep. 9
descripcion: Thor wakes up and his hammer is gone, so the gods dress the god of thunder as a bride to get it back. Then he walks into the hall of Utgarda-Loki, where every contest is rigged and the truth explains the tides, thunder and old age. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: The Death of Baldr | Norse Mythology Ep. 10
descripcion: Baldr, the most beloved of the gods, dreamed of his own death, and his mother made every living thing swear not to harm him. Every thing but one: a young sprig of mistletoe, which Loki turned into a dart. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: Loki Bound | Norse Mythology Ep. 11
descripcion: After the feast of Aegir, where Loki insulted every god in the hall, the gods hunted him down: a salmon in a waterfall, a net woven from ashes, and a chain made of his own son's entrails. Now he lies beneath a dripping serpent, and when his wife's bowl runs full, the whole earth shakes. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: Ragnarök | Norse Mythology Ep. 12
descripcion: Three winters without a summer, wolves that swallow the Sun, and chains that finally break. This is Ragnarök, the last battle of the Norse gods, told as the poets of Iceland recorded it. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings

titulo: The World Reborn | Norse Mythology Ep. 13
descripcion: After Ragnarok, the world sank beneath the sea, and then it rose again, green and new. Two humans survived on morning dew, Baldr came back from Hel, and the gods found the golden game pieces they had played with at the dawn of time. Watch the full animated episode on YouTube. #NorseMythology #Mythology #Vikings
